Storage.//: Per-environment bucket names (DEF-015). On-prem/dev keeps the historical MinIO split; the cloud stack sets BOTH to the single per-env S3 bucket created by deploy/aws/02-s3.sh (ADR-0035).

Minio.//region: SigV4 signing scope. Against a real AWS endpoint the SDK ALSO derives the request host from it (Minio 6.0.3 AWSS3Endpoints: us-east-1 => s3.amazonaws.com, path-style), so this is what the CSP media-src origin must match. MinIO ignores it.
Minio.//: PublicEndpoint = browser-reachable object-store host used ONLY to presign recording playback URLs (ADR-0014); on-prem that is the app origin, proxied to MinIO by nginx. Empty => presign with the internal client (local dev, and the cloud stack, which presigns straight to S3). Uploads always use Endpoint.

Webex.//: P13 Webex adapter (ADR-0005). Enabled=false => adapter not wired; in-app is the sole channel (AC-071). All secrets via env vars, never committed. SignatureAlgorithm = HMACSHA1 (Webex default) | HMACSHA256 | HMACSHA512.

ActionReminders.//: W22 / docs29 §3.4 reminder+escalation sweep (app-owned Hangfire, ADR-0014). Days-based thresholds; OverdueMode = Once | DailyWhileOverdue; SweepCron = Hangfire CRON (default daily 06:00).

Keycloak.//: Keycloak OIDC realm (ADR-0004). Empty Authority => every token is rejected and protected endpoints return 401 (fail-closed). Set per environment via env vars.

RoleMapping.//: Keycloak claim -> canonical ACMP role. Standard shapes are handled automatically; ClaimToRole adds overrides. DefaultRole=null => deny when a validated token carries no recognised role (AC-003).
